GET IN TOUCH

Help make the guides better.

Use the Deskwise Guide project issue tracker for editorial questions, corrections and site problems.

Open a project issue ↗

For a useful correction

Include the guide URL, the sentence or feature concerned and a manufacturer or other primary reference if available. For a display problem, mention your browser and screen size. A GitHub account is required to post.

Keep personal information private

Project issues are public. Do not post addresses, phone numbers, order numbers, passwords, identity documents or other sensitive details. For account-specific privacy requests, use GitHub's available privacy and support routes rather than publishing personal data in an issue.

Store orders and returns

Deskwise does not sell or ship the products shown in linked stores. For an order, warranty, payment or return, contact the seller or marketplace directly. We cannot access your Amazon account.
